verdict.reason: The help pages explain how 429 responses work on status routes and how to space out polling, which covers the customer's status-check loop, though the page does not say which endpoint their loop calls or why the whole workflow stops.

steps.text: After a 429, stop sending requests to the limited route.
If the 429 response gives a retry interval, wait for that interval.
Reduce concurrency and request frequency before resuming.
Get Post Status allows 60 requests per minute and asks for at least 10 seconds between status requests.
